statements: CREATE TABLE "assistants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "ai_connections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "skills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "mcp_servers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "assistant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assistants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('user', 'assistant')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (conversation_id, position))

CREATE TABLE "generation_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "checkpoint" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "message_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES generation_runs (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "is_draft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("is_draft" IN (0, 1)), "is_selected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("is_selected" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "reasoning_content" TEXT NULL, "model_name" TEXT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (message_id, position))

CREATE TABLE "revision_attachments" ("revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES message_revisions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("revision_id", "position"))

CREATE TABLE "tool_invocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES generation_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "call_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (run_id, call_id))

CREATE TABLE "model_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "engine" TEXT NOT NULL, "runtime_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (engine, path))
CREATE TABLE "speech_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "voice_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "voice_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "download_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "pending_file_deletions" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('chatAttachment', 'speechJob', 'voiceProfile')), PRIMARY KEY ("path"))
CREATE TABLE "app_metadata" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))
CREATE INDEX conversations_recent ON conversations (updated_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX conversations_assistant ON conversations (assistant_id, updated_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX revisions_run ON message_revisions (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX revisions_selected ON message_revisions (message_id) WHERE is_selected = 1
CREATE INDEX attachments_path ON revision_attachments (path)
CREATE INDEX runs_conversation ON generation_runs (conversation_id, updated_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX runs_active ON generation_runs (state) WHERE state IN ('running', 'awaitingApproval', 'cancelling')
CREATE INDEX invocations_run ON tool_invocations (run_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX speech_jobs_recent ON speech_jobs (created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX speech_jobs_asset ON speech_jobs (asset_id, state)
CREATE INDEX speech_jobs_voice ON speech_jobs (voice_id, state)
CREATE INDEX speech_jobs_state ON speech_jobs (state)
CREATE INDEX voices_name ON voice_profiles (name, id)
CREATE INDEX downloads_recent ON download_tasks (created_at DESC, id)
